meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 的回答会变成：第一行就给出可立即执行的动作；多步骤任务用编号列表；每轮回复重述当前进度；给出具体时间估算；明确展示已完成的事项；同时去掉开场白、客套话和离题内容。
howto.when: 当用户输入“/i-have-adhd”时开启，之后对所有消息自动生效，直到用户说“stop adhd mode”结束。

say.note: 关闭该模式，恢复普通回复。

say.text: 按ADHD模式把下一步行动和编号列出来
say.note: 回复会以行动开头并用编号步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's replies become: first line gives an immediately actionable step; multi-step tasks are numbered lists; each turn restates current progress; specific time estimates; completed work shown clearly; no preambles, pleasantries, or tangents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user types "/i-have-adhd"; then applies to all messages until the user says "stop adhd mode".

say_en.note: Turns it off, back to normal replies.

say_en.text: Give the next action and numbered steps in ADHD mode.
say_en.note: Reply starts with an action and uses numbered steps.
